blockingIssues.description: The new validation harness only generates a usable recovery link when `SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET` is configured. Without that env var it renders a 'Missing secret configuration' message and no actionable recovery URL, which means it does not leave behind the deterministic entitled public booking-validation path/harness the feature contract requires for later validators. The worker transcript also shows browser use of the harness falling through to `/auth/signin?redirectedFrom=%2Fbookings%2Frecover...`, confirming the harness was not self-sufficient for live entitled detail coverage in this environment.

The new 'passes the same shared detail model to the guest booking detail route' test never exercises the public `/bookings/[bookingId]` route and only asserts that the guest route returns a truthy page. That misses the contract that public and guest booking detail must share one model while preserving route-appropriate behavior on the public route, so the feature's core reuse requirement remains unverified. The later fix feature `fix-public-booking-detail-return-intent` exists because this gap shipped.

The unauthenticated public detail assertion expects a direct sign-in redirect from `/bookings/[bookingId]`. The implemented product behavior routes public detail through `/bookings/recover?next=...` before sign-in so recovery continuity and token stripping can work. This test encoded the wrong contract for the public route, which scrutiny later had to correct with follow-up fixes.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The mission instructions told reviewers to inspect `.factory/services.yaml` at the repo root, but the actual file lives under the project worktree (`<repo>/.factory/services.yaml`). The direct mission-path lookup failed during review setup.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reading `/Users/amankumarshrestha/.factory/services.yaml` returned ENOENT, while `/Users/amankumarshrestha/LapenInns Project/nabatableLP-guest-design-system-20260325-0745/.factory/services.yaml` exists and contains the service manifest.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Library guidance documents the dev auth-validation harness but not the new booking-recovery harness or its dependency on `SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET`, so future validators still need to rediscover how the booking-recovery path is supposed to be exercised.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `.factory/library/user-testing.md` documents `/dev/auth-validation` scenarios but has no mention of `/dev/booking-recovery` or `SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET`; the only repo/library reference to the booking-recovery harness is the implementation file `src/app/(public)/dev/booking-recovery/page.tsx`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The feature commit included Playwright state output in `test-results/.last-run.json`, which is not product code and does not appear to be covered by the shared services/process guidance.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: git show --stat 9a101996f248ead089ee74606780d6a08034e5dc lists `test-results/.last-run.json` as part of the commit alongside the real source/test changes.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The guest-ui-worker skill still instructs workers to run `npx vitest run --maxWorkers=9` after implementation, but this worker explicitly skipped the post-change full-suite rerun and still marked `followedProcedure` false only in handoff feedback. The skill may need clearer guidance on when a targeted regression run is acceptable for narrow fixes.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Handoff skillFeedback for session f11ba3b9-a9f9-4580-9ef7-2b7b6d6a668d says the worker did not rerun the full suite after code changes; `.factory/skills/guest-ui-worker/SKILL.md` step 6 currently lists the full Vitest rerun unconditionally.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The feature's required Playwright command depends on a Playwright-managed app on port 5180, but `.factory/services.yaml` only documents the port-3000 dev server. This mismatch keeps surfacing as an environment failure rather than a product issue.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature handoff records `PLAYWRIGHT_DEV_HARNESS=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/guest-booking.spec.ts tests/e2e/guest-booking-manage.spec.ts --workers=1` failing with `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` on `http://localhost:5180`, while `.factory/services.yaml` defines only `web` on port 3000.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Shared route knowledge is now split between `.factory/library/guest-routes.md` and the newer scrutiny findings. The library still documents `/guest/thank-you` only as deprecated, without recording that the canonical destination is `/bookings` rather than `/guest/dashboard`.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `.factory/library/guest-routes.md` says only '/guest/thank-you is deprecated and should not remain a primary destination', while `src/app/guest/thank-you/page.tsx:6-9` now redirects to `/bookings` and `tests/e2e/guest-receipt-pages.spec.ts:103-109` verifies that destination.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The guest-ui-worker skill currently requires agent-browser validation and a full Vitest rerun for all guest-ui tasks, but this feature only changed a unit-test fixture and had no runtime UI surface to verify. The worker deviated by using targeted automated verification only, and that deviation appears justified for this class of test-only cleanup work.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Handoff skillFeedback marks followedProcedure=false and explains skipping agent-browser/full-suite rerun for this non-UI fixture cleanup; the commit diff only touches tests/guest/guest-receipt-pages.test.tsx.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The recovery continuity flow and dev harness both depend on SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET, but the shared environment notes still do not document that prerequisite for future reviewers/validators exercising booking recovery continuity.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: src/app/(public)/bookings/[bookingId]/page.tsx:53-64 gates continuation token minting on SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET and src/app/(public)/dev/booking-recovery/page.tsx:34-48 only generates a live recovery link when that secret is present, while .factory/library/environment.md omits this recovery-specific env requirement.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The `guest-ui-worker` skill says to write a targeted RED test proving the intended behavior before implementation. The worker added only tests, but those tests did not exercise the public shared-detail reuse path and one asserted the wrong redirect contract, so the procedure as applied did not protect the feature's main requirement.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Skill file `.factory/skills/guest-ui-worker/SKILL.md` step 4 requires RED coverage proving intended guest behavior; transcript/handoff for session `b196dee9-8565-422e-bd28-ef8d7db710a0` shows only `tests/guest/public-booking-pages.test.tsx` was added in commit `aedf616e`, and that file's lines 148-152 and 168-199 miss/misstate the public-route contract.
